items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy Nottingham used to come by

ctx.x: Well, my friends... well mostly it was her family. She had a big family, they'd come by, you know; some of them even stayed there for a little while, different ones. But the musicians, Denzil Best used to come by; Budd Johnson used to come by all the time 'cause he lived out there. In fact, his wife was a real estate agent and she...they sold us our house. And Timmie Kennedy...he's in that Ebony magazine... they didn't list his name, but he's sittin' down
there when 'Cherry Red' is dancin'. And, let's see who else, Jimmy Nottingham used to come by and Jimmy Jones was there all the time and Joe Newman and Al McKibbon, you know. J.C. Heard, you know.
You and Al McKibbon were in quite a few bands together, weren't you?
